caption:
Every solar salesman asks for your electric bill. For a battery, that's not enough. Here's what's missing. Sources on the last slide.

Follow for more plain-English Oʻahu solar math.

#Oahu #HawaiiSolar #SolarPower #HawaiianElectric #Honolulu

slides.text: A battery quote that doesn't ask when you use power is just a guess.

Your bill shows how much energy you use each month.
Your battery needs to know how much you use each day.

If they guess wrong:
Too small: your extra solar goes to the grid for 13.5¢ instead of into your evening.
Too big: you paid for storage you never fill.
Same house, same panels. Three battery sizes.

chart.note: Illustrative: one day of solar from the same panels (solid bars = 100%). Hatched = empty battery capacity, not energy. Export credit: Rule 32 Smart Export, midday, Oʻahu agreements Apr 2024–Apr 2027.

slides.text: Ask every installer: “What evening usage did you size this battery to?”
slides.sub: If they only looked at your monthly total, ask how they knew.
